import re, importlib.util
all_user='\n'.join(part.get('text','') for m in msgs if m.get('role')=='user' for part in m.get('content',[]) if part.get('type')=='text')
# each input/output label block, collect until next Demo label or non-grid marker
pairs=[]
for i in (1,2):
    m=re.search(rf'Demo pair {i} input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair {i} output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance\.|\Z)', all_user, re.S)
    print('pair',i,'found',bool(m))
    h,w=m.group(1,2)
    def parse_block(s):
        lines=[ln for ln in s.strip().splitlines() if re.fullmatch(r'\s*[0-9](?:\s+[0-9])*\s*',ln)]
        return [[int(x) for x in ln.split()] for ln in lines]
    inp,out=parse_block(m.group(3)),parse_block(m.group(4))
    print(len(inp), [len(x) for x in inp[:2]], len(out), [len(x) for x in out[:2]])
    pairs.append((inp,out))
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',program_path); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
for i,(inp,out) in enumerate(pairs,1):
    got=mod.transform(inp)
    print('pair',i,'match=',got==out,'changed',sum(a!=b for ra,rb in zip(inp,got) for a,b in zip(ra,rb)))
